name: mirage
description: A pure-JavaScript MS-DOS machine with a source-level x86→JS dynamic recompiler.

scripts.demos: nasm -f bin demos/xormunch.asm -o demos/XORMUNCH.COM && nasm -f bin demos/plasma13.asm -o demos/PLASMA13.COM
scripts.test:all: node tools/test.js && node tools/test-dos-api.js && node tools/test-dos.js && node tools/test-gfx.js && node tools/test-demos.js && node tools/golden.js
